notes: IEEE 1516.1-2025 public-API three-federate ownership scenario: a requester seeks acquisition, the owner offers negotiated divestiture, and a separate published candidate receives a grouped tagged Request Attribute Ownership Assumption while owner confirmation is pending. Ownership remains with the owner until Confirm Divestiture, after which the requester receives a tagged acquisition notification and owns the attribute. The pinned native selection page-154-l9-2 -> §7.2 maps the assumption callback; other callback metadata and ownership checks are supplemental public-API observations, not additional invented requirements. Process endpoint, pushed transport, and private registry mechanics are excluded. Adapter supplies provider, endpoint, FOM, names, callback model and logical-time implementation. Current-source installed-package C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 under evoked/immediate callbacks. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime execution evidence. This is not a conformance claim.
